MY LITTLE PET · TEJA PRIYAN

Donations & refunds

Free, Plus and the mobile room cost nothing. There are no game purchases, pre-orders or subscriptions to cancel, and no app purchase charge to refund.

Optional support

A contribution through Buy Me a Coffee is separate from game access. If you have a problem with a contribution, contact that service and email teja1616150@gmail.com with the relevant receipt reference. Do not send card numbers. Refund eligibility and processing depend on the service’s terms and applicable law; a refund is not automatically guaranteed.

You can stop using or uninstall the game at any time. Export your save first if you want to keep it.
